title: Lost Vape UB Ultra Replacement Coil for Centaurus B60 Kit / Centaurus B80 Kit (5pcs/pack)
description:
Lost Vape UB Ultra Replacement Coil for Centaurus B60 Kit / Centaurus B80 Kit (5pcs/pack)
The UB Ultra Replacement Coils are perfectly compatible with Lost Vape
Centaurus Q80 Kit, Centaurus B60 Kit and Centaurus B80 Kit.
Resistance:
UB ULTRA V3 M3 0.15ohm (60-80W)
UB ULTRA V3 M4 0.2ohm (40-60W)
UB ULTRA V3 M6 0.3ohm (30-40W)
UB ULTRA V3 M8 0.15ohm (60-80W)
Package Unit: 5pcs/pack
Brand
:
Lost Vape
Product Type
:
Replacement Coils
Package Contents:
1 x 5pcs Lost Vape UB Ultra Coils
Note
: Before using these coils, they must be primed. Before vaping, the organic cotton around the coil must be completely saturated. Fill the cotton wicks around the coil with a few drops of
e-liquid
. Fill the tank with liquid and let it stand upright for at least 10 minutes (longer in cooler temperatures). A faster approach to prime it is to draw through the tank a few times without firing.
